tools.name: search_waters
tools.description: Search public waters by name. Optional two-letter state. Only states open for indexing are returned, each with its castthewater.com page URL. At most 25 hits.

tools.name: get_recent_stockings
tools.description: Recent stocking events in one open state. Optional county and species. since_days defaults to 14 and must be from 1 to 90. Estimated dates keep the around wording and are not exact days. At most 25 events.

tools.name: get_water
tools.description: One public water by id or slug: stocking history, species, and depth or water level when we have them, plus its castthewater.com page URL. A closed state is not available.

tools.name: search_waterbodies
tools.description: Search water bodies by name (or nearest town name). Optional state filter. Only states open for indexing are returned. Prefer this over county browse.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search US census places (cities/towns) by name in states open for indexing. Use the lat/lon of a hit with find_nearby.

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Find water bodies near a lat/lon in states open for indexing. At most 25 hits from a bbox query. Filters: radius, species, min acres, stocked-only, recent stocking window, optional amenity feature flag.

tools.name: get_waterbody
tools.description: Full water body detail for a state open for indexing: identity, size/shoreline, structured nearest_town + nearest_town_label, stocking, natural species, surveys, editorial content (incl. gauge_relationship / gauge_notes), gallery, regs link, gauge. Pass id or seo_path (state/county/slug). A closed s

tools.name: get_stocking_history
tools.description: Stocking events for a water body in a state open for indexing. Year-only dates are 'sometime in YYYY' with estimated true. An around date stays an estimate.

tools.name: get_species
tools.description: Likely natural species (USGS GAP HUC8) and survey abundance rows for a water body in a state open for indexing. A closed state is not available.

tools.name: get_conditions
tools.description: Conditions for a water in a state open for indexing. Reads the existing forecast and USGS cache only: a miss is unavailable, with the canonical page URL. No live fetch.

tools.name: get_nearby_waterbodies
tools.description: Nearby water bodies in states open for indexing, for internal linking / trip planning. A closed state is not available.
